proposed.name: cross-turn tactical tempo (SHADOW / PROPOSED — isolated, never wired to production Hard Cat)
proposed.definition: mouseTurnsToGoal=ceil(mouseWinRouteDistance/mouseBaseMoves); catTurnsToGate=ceil(catHoleGateDistance/catBaseMoves); margin=catTurnsToGate−mouseTurnsToGoal (in TURNS; negative=cat guards the gate before the mouse arrives)
proposed.distinctionFromExisting: existing tempo sees only the current-turn moves-left difference (identical at a turn boundary); the proposed signal measures the multi-turn butter-to-hole race vs the cat gate-interception race, which DOES differ between cat endpoints.
